messages:
Andrea L.: Heads-up: marketplace teams asked for a pinned driver/CUDA/ROCm matrix for the next image. Need partner sign-off + SI test schedule. Who can own partner comms?
Ken T.: I can take partner comms. Timeline?
Andrea L.: Target announce next Tue. Need pin recs + rollback/hotfix playbook by Fri EOD so marketplace listings and SI bundles can freeze. Confirm SI integration coverage.
Maria S.: Nightly regression: CUDA 12.2 + cuDNN9 on some A2 SKUs shows mem spikes and intermittent OOMs for quant workloads.
Ken T.: Infra runs: most-stable so far = CUDA 12.1 + NVIDIA driver 535.86, ROCm 5.3 + kernel 6.1. Partners need to confirm hotfix windows for 535.x -> 545.x.
Liz P.: Proposal: default marketplace image pins to 12.1/535, offer opt-in canary lane for CUDA 12.2/driver 545 so SIs can validate new features without risking default images.
Sam R.: Ops: we can add canary lanes in Dedicated & Private. Maintenance window available Fri 02:00 UTC to start smoke canaries.
devops-bot: scheduled canary smoke for marketplace-image: job=PR-4821, window=2024-11-15T02:00:00Z
Andrea L.: @Ken T. loop in NVIDIA/AMD: (1) confirm recommended pin set, (2) share planned hotfix timelines that affect 535.x->545.x, (3) list kernel/ABI constraints for on-prem SI. Also ask SI leads to run top-10 workloads against pinned set.
Ken T.: Draft to partners:
---
Hello partners,
We propose default pin: CUDA 12.1 | NVIDIA driver 535.86 | ROCm 5.3 | Linux kernel 6.1.
Opt-in canary: CUDA 12.2 | NVIDIA driver 545.x (experimental).
Please confirm incompatibilities or scheduled hotfixes impacting these pins by Fri EOD.
SI ask: run top-10 customer workloads against default pin and report regressions + perf deltas to TICKET-8732.
Rollback/fallback:
- Canary cutoff: >5% p99 latency or >3% top-5 model error regression => auto-fallback
- Fallback: map marketplace routing to previous image tag + alert oncall
Thanks, Ken (Redwood Partnerships)
---
Ken T.: Anyone object to sending that?
Maria S.: Add note about quant kernel regressions in 12.2: lower INT8 accuracy in a fused matmul kernel seen in our quant-suite. Partners should check fused-kernel diffs.
Liz P.: Also add rollback bullets: image tag mapping, canary cutoff metrics, and routing fallback steps.
Sam R.: I'll draft the SI runbook: canary checklist, telemetry queries, incident contacts. Will push a PR by EOD and gate it on TICKET-8732 being linked.
Ken T.: Sending at 10:00 PST tomorrow and CC SI leads. Posting to partners now.
deploy-bot: release-note RN-2024-0452 created for marketplace image pins
devops-bot: canary finished (job=PR-4821): 8/8 smoke tests passed; no regressions observed in top-5 workloads
Maria S.: Note: T4 quant bench showed latency spike at seq_len=8 in quant pipeline. Filed TICKET-8732 with logs + perf traces.
Andrea L.: Great. Ken, send at 10:00 PST and CC SI leads. Sam, gate KB PR on that ticket link. :thumbsup:
Ken T.: Will do. Thanks everyone.
